description: A single credential source to copy into the container: either a reference to a named catalog bundle (bundle), or an ad-hoc host/container file pair (host + container). Exactly one form must be used; enforced at profile-apply time, not by this schema.

bundle.description: Name of a built-in credential bundle (e.g. "claude", "ollama") to copy into the container

host.description: Ad-hoc host path to copy (supports ~ expansion)

container.description: Ad-hoc absolute path inside the container where the host file is copied

mode.description: Optional chmod mode applied after copying, e.g. "0600"
